question: Does INT-210 Done mean commercial launch is approved?

claims.text: INT-210 implementation being Done does not mean commercial launch is approved; commercial launch for INT-210 remains Pending approval.

supports.quote: INT-210 implementation is Done; commercial launch remains Pending approval.

uncertainties: Synthesized from current authorized evidence; exact supporting quotes and a separate model review were checked. Model review can miss errors; verify important conclusions.
